# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Exact calendar helpers (MODEL.md, "Calendar and clock lineages").
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def phase_of(boundary, period):
    """Phase of an absolute boundary index."""
    return boundary % period


def slice_position(boundary, interval_ns, slice_ns, offset_ns, n_slices):
    """Slice index and offset inside the slice of an absolute boundary.

    The nominal time of boundary ``t`` is ``offset_ns + t*interval_ns``; the
    transmission uses slice ``floor(time/slice_ns) mod n_slices`` and the
    position ``time mod slice_ns`` inside that slice.
    """
    nominal = offset_ns + boundary * interval_ns
    return (nominal // slice_ns) % n_slices, nominal % slice_ns


def period_rounds(interval_ns, slice_ns, n_slices):
    """Smallest positive P with P*interval_ns divisible by n_slices*slice_ns."""
    import math
    m = n_slices * slice_ns
    return m // math.gcd(interval_ns, m)
